phase: interrupted v3 partial review, not final regression

interruption.reason: Coordinator stopped v3 after browser testing exposed a P1 text-consent loop before the first submission draft. Preserve partial evidence; await successful browser workflow before another full run.

limitations: Only completed transcripts were reviewed. No claim of complete 40-case result.
The final bytes/schema guards and subsequent browser fix are newer than this report and must be tested in the final frozen candidate.
File-selection request text is not end-to-end file-upload evidence.
All later runs are regression, not a new blind holdout.
improvements_observed: Clear licence/payment and physical issue requests reach an appropriate answer or human-fact clarification instead of an unrelated service-card gate.
Open/InProgress labels are no longer treated as proof of dispatch, no work started, or a repair schedule.
Successful submission response comes from the actual receipt and expressly states local-only simulation and no notification/refund.
Photo request uses file-kind UI instead of a text-only request to upload.
Arabic list questions contain normal newline characters.
Alternative public complaint is generally expressed as an explicit choice; no silent fallback write observed.

confirmed_residual_findings.category: Local simulated attachment incorrectly promised visible in official app
confirmed_residual_findings.exact_evidence: You can view the attachment in the official Balady app or website with the same account.
confirmed_residual_findings.context: The same question identifies the synthetic local report and says its file reference is unavailable. There is no evidence the local report or attachment exists in any official channel.
confirmed_residual_findings.root_cause: Only success-after-write output is receipt-controlled; general answers and request_input.question remain unconstrained model prose.
confirmed_residual_findings.recommendation: Apply the simulation and evidence boundary to all citizen-facing content paths. For an unavailable local attachment, state it cannot be retrieved here and avoid claiming it can be recovered with the same account elsewhere.

warnings.category: Responsible authority inferred without jurisdiction evidence
warnings.exact_evidence: Water leaking from the pavement is usually handled by the municipality (and the water utility for the pipe itself).
warnings.assessment: Hedged rather than a guaranteed dispatch, but city and asset owner are unknown and no authority field/verified FAQ supports the statement. Ask location, then explain connected limits without assigning responsibility.
